_note: Live-event skins (shown with the original app's EN CURSO treatment while date <= today <= endDate, then dropped automatically) and officially confirmed upcoming skins. Checked 2026-11-21 against official MLBB posts and the MLBB Wiki. Every card needs official landscape splash art (portrait-only skins stay hidden until the wiki has a wide splash). 'pending' = officially confirmed skins without landscape art yet; they appear automatically once the wiki uploads '<Hero> (<Skin>).jpg/png' as a wide splash. liveDays = assumed run length when Moonton hasn't announced the end date.
